title.en: Validate a recipe, see an invalid one fail, and publish its hash

goal.en: A publisher validates against the recipe schema (the one kind the hub checks in full), sees what a non-recipe gets back, and computes the hash that executors compare with ExecuteRequest.recipeHash.

note.en: Validate it as a recipe: no errors.
A document that is not a recipe fails with thirteen errors, one per required property plus the unknown field.
The recipe's hash: an executor refuses a request whose recipeHash differs (recipe_hash_mismatch, scenario 097).

outcome.en: You can validate and hash before you publish, and put the hash in a registry entry. Next: 100 verifies a recall that travelled through a mirror.
